svg.title: Lianum: current deployment architecture
svg.desc: Current deployment. The mobile wallet holds the keys and talks to an API host on Google Compute Engine (Caddy, API gateway, native wallet relay and the AI agent). A private engine host runs PAEG and the zero-knowledge proof workers, reachable only from the API host. The agent plans payments; the owner grants one permission per plan and the engine executes it on Ethereum Sepolia, Bitcoin Testnet3 and Solana devnet.
svg.text: Compute Engine · e2-small · Debian 12 · static IP · ports 80/443
Compute Engine · n2-standard-4 · 16 GiB · no public IP
No inbound path to the engine
Server keys · no user root keys
